description:
Before the show, get into the mood.

A quiet countdown for your next concert, festival, or livehouse. Not a ticket wallet. Not an itinerary. Just a private space to slowly get closer to this one night.

Save up to 15 shows for free. A Home Screen widget can keep the countdown in sight.

BeforeShow helps you:
• See the next show — the home screen holds one current show and its countdown
• Light reminders — only using facts you already saved
• Bring a show in — paste a link, scan a screenshot, or type it yourself
• Keep the night — a short rating, a note, and memory fragments that stay yours
• Festival timetable — every stage side by side, overlaps at a glance
• Pre-show listening — stage-by-stage mixes to warm up before doors open
• Lock Screen countdown — Live Activity and Dynamic Island show who's on stage
• Home Screen widgets — see how long is left without opening the app

How it works
1. Save your next concert, festival, or livehouse
2. Watch the countdown as the night gets closer
3. After the show, leave something behind and find it later in Footprints

The free plan includes capacity for 15 saved shows; deleting a show frees capacity. Pro is a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase, and unlocks unlimited new shows. Prices are shown in the App Store at purchase.

promotionalText: Rebuilt Listen and a new pin wall in Footprints, plus two-column layouts on iPad and iPhone Duo.
whatsNew:
Pick a disc, your way.

"Pick a disc for me" now comes in four styles: 3D Record Shelf, One per Screen, Front-Facing Rack and Carousel. The 3D Record Shelf swings the whole row in from the side and slides your pick out, and every style opens faster. 3D Record Shelf and Carousel are Pro styles, with 3 free tries.

Over the Years in Footprints is now a gallery corridor that walks itself from your latest show back to your first.

Adding a show is rebuilt, and shows that end after midnight now save. Once your last show has ended, a newly added show becomes your current show.

Fixed the mini player not switching when you play an album after a video.
